title: Paraphrase: Ancient City of Petra

sourceText: The ancient city of Petra, located in the desert canyons of Jordan, is one of the most remarkable archaeological sites in the world. Carved directly into vibrant red and pink sandstone cliffs, it was the capital of the Nabataean kingdom from around 400 B.C. to 106 A.D. The city was strategically positioned on a major trade route, which allowed its inhabitants to prosper by taxing passing caravans.
